import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.close();

        Arrays.sort(a);

        int ans = 1;
        int l = 0;
        for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
            while (l <= r && a[r] - a[l] > T) {
                l++;
            }
            if (l <= r) {
                ans = Math.max(ans, r - l + 1);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
